title: doit config show
description: Every value doit resolved on this machine, and where each came from. An empty value means nothing set it. client_secret holds `set` where the variable is set, and never the secret.

source.description: The kind of place that set the value. Empty where nothing did.

from.description: The config file's path, or the variable that set the value. Empty for a default or a hostname.

issuer.description: The login server the service trusts.

client_id.description: The client this machine logs in as.

token_command.description: The command that hands this machine its tokens, where the config file names one.

client_secret.description: Whether a service client's secret is set.

config_file.description: The file holding api, issuer and client_id.

cache_dir.description: Where doit keeps what the shell reads with no request.

state_dir.description: Where doit keeps an edit the service never took.

editor.description: The program each edit verb opens.

machine.description: The name written on every journal record from this machine.

actor.description: The identity written on every journal record from this process.
